title: validation event
description: Event-log line written for each publish action the owner validates with ok (or go or approve where they publish). Same record as req_030 Need 5: {mission, version, action, target, payload_sha256, owner_event, ts}, chained by hash. core checks it before that action.

actor.description: Only the owner validates; never a chat surface, the butler or a run.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this action's entry in the block's publish list.

owner_event.description: ts of the owner's answer event that carried the verb.

prev_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous validation line of the mission as stored, 64 zeros for the first. Breaks on a replayed or edited record.

dropped_by.description: ts of the owner message that dropped it (validation_dropped only).
